timeline.summary: On May 4, 2026, Rainbow Children's Medicare commissioned a 60-bed spoke hospital in HRBR Layout and an IVF centre in Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, with a total project cost of ₹52 Cr.

On May 8, 2026, Rainbow Children's Medicare informed the exchanges that its appeal against a DGGI GST demand notice was disallowed by the Principal Commissioner of Customs and Central Tax (Appeals-1).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹459.9 Cr (+24.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹77.04 Cr (+36.7% YoY).
On May 23, 2026, Rainbow Children's Medicare filed its Q4 and FY26 earnings presentation showing a 24% YoY rise in quarterly operating revenue to ₹459.9 crore.
Rainbow Children's Medicare Limited hosted a conference call with investors/analysts on May 25, 2026, at 10:00 AM (IST) to discuss Q4 & FY2026 performance, with audio available on its website.
Rainbow Childrens Medicare targeted 20% revenue growth for FY27 during its Q4FY26 earnings call, outlining a ~900-bed execution pipeline.
On its Q1FY27 call (July 31, 2026), Rainbow guided to crossing ₹2,000 Cr revenue in FY27 and adding 2,500 beds over five years at about ₹2,200 Cr capex.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹548.02 Cr (+23.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹82.09 Cr (+9.1% YoY).
Rainbow Childrens Medicare released its Q2 FY27 investor presentation, reporting 23.2% YoY revenue growth to ₹548 Cr and detailing its build-out path to 5,000+ beds by FY32.
